description:
Set the manager persona shown on the fund's PUBLIC page.

    Args:
        fund_id: Your fund.
        persona_name: Display name, e.g. "Grandma Prudence".
        avatar: One emoji, e.g. "👵".
        tagline: One line under the name.
        manager_kind: "human" or "ai". With "ai", the platform's AI loop can
            run the fund on a schedule using ai_prompt.
        philosophy: The fund's investment philosophy (public).
        ai_prompt: System prompt for the platform AI manager (public).
        ai_enabled: Let the platform AI decide on a schedule.
        ai_cadence_hours: How often the AI decides (1-168).
        ai_use_search: Let the AI read live news via grounded search.
        socials: {"twitter": "@x", "website": "...", "discord", "telegram", "github", "youtube"}.
name: set_manager_profile
